name: com.agentscouthq/directory
title: AgentScout
description: Free, read-only search over 6,000+ AI agent tools and 3,200+ MCP servers. No sign-up.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the AgentScout directory of AI agent tools and MCP servers by keyword, with optional category, pricing, open-source and data-locality (runs_locally) filters. Each result has data_locality (offline, self_hosted, cloud or unknown) with a plain note. Returns up to 25 matches with pricing as the maker states it and the AgentScout listing URL.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'browser automation' or 'postgres'. Optional if a filter is set.

category.description: Exact category name from list_categories, e.g. 'MCP servers'.

pricing.description: Pricing type. 'freemium' = free plan plus paid plans.

runs_locally.description: Where the tool can run, so data can stay on your side. 'offline' = runs fully on your own machine (e.g. with local models). 'self_hosted_or_offline' = also includes tools you can deploy on your own server. 'any' (default) = no filter. Based on what each listing says; tools without clear evidence are excluded from both filters.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full AgentScout listing for one tool by its slug (from search_tools results), including key features, platforms, GitHub repo and stars, and data_locality with the evidence phrase.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every AgentScout category with its tool count and page URL.

tools.name: best_for_task
tools.description: Suggest AgentScout tools for a task described in plain words (e.g. 'scrape websites with an agent'), ranked by relevance with listed GitHub stars as a tiebreak. Optional pricing, open-source and runs_locally filters; use runs_locally when data must stay on the user's machine or servers (e.g. 'no-code automation that runs locally').

task.description: What you want to get done.

runs_locally.description: Where the tool can run, so data can stay on your side. 'offline' = runs fully on your own machine (e.g. with local models). 'self_hosted_or_offline' = also includes tools you can deploy on your own server. 'any' (default) = no filter. Based on what each listing says; tools without clear evidence are excluded from both filters.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List AgentScout's 4 maker listing packages ($0, $15 Fast-Track with a same-day Bing and IndexNow ping, $49 category pin, $99/wk sponsor) and the Made by AgentScout pre-trained bot lineup. The $99 weekly sponsorship includes submissions to about 25 other AI directories. That work is not a separate listing tier.

category.description: Filter by product category (default 'all'). Directory submissions come with the $99 weekly sponsor, not a separate addon.
